posts.lede: Home sales jumped 14% from September while benchmark prices barely moved. Buyers still hold the advantage.
posts.source: Source: Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, October 2026 market report. Benchmark prices, MLS® HPI. Not intended to solicit properties currently listed for sale.
posts.caption:
📊 Fraser Valley market update: October 2026

Buyers came back in October. Sales rose 14% from September to 1,051 homes, while prices stayed almost flat:

🏡 Detached benchmark: $1,293,800 (down 8.5% from last year)
🏘️ Townhome: $742,300 (down 5.5%)
🏢 Apartment: $460,800 (down 8.1%)

📉 Active listings fell to 9,164
⚖️ Sales-to-active ratio: 11%, still a buyer's market (balanced is 12–20%)

The board's CEO put it simply: "Much of the pandemic-era price growth in the Fraser Valley has been erased." If you've been waiting, this is the window. DM me or call 604.562.4004 for a free price check on any neighbourhood in Surrey, Langley or Delta.

posts.cta: Ask me which homes are near a future station
posts.source: Source: TransLink/TI Corp Surrey Langley SkyTrain status report, May 2026: 16 km, 8 stations along Fraser Highway, in service expected late 2029.
posts.caption:
🚆 SkyTrain is coming to Fraser Highway.

The Surrey Langley SkyTrain will extend the Expo Line 16 km from King George Station to Langley City Centre, with 8 new stations:

📍 Green Timbers (140 St)
📍 152 Street
📍 Fleetwood (160 St)
📍 Bakerview-166 Street
📍 Hillcrest-184 Street
📍 Clayton (189 St)
📍 Willowbrook (196 St)
📍 Langley City Centre (203 St)

Service is expected to start in late 2029, according to the project's latest status report. Homes within walking distance of a station are worth a close look, whether you're buying to live or to invest.

Want a list of homes near a future station? DM me "SKYTRAIN" or call 604.562.4004.
